prompt:
A snail moves at a speed of $\frac{(12)}{(19)}$ inches per minute. What is this speed in feet per minute? ($12$ inches $= 1$ foot)

$$0$$

$$\frac{1}{19},.0526,0.052,0.053$$
explanation: The correct answer is $\frac{1}{19}$. It's given that the snail moves at a speed of $\frac{12}{19}$ inches per minute and $12$ inches $= 1$ foot. It follows that this speed is equivalent to $\left( \frac{\frac{12}{19} \text{ inches}}{1 \text{ minute}} \right) \left( \frac{1 \text{ foot}}{12 \text{ inches}} \right)$, or $\frac{12}{19} \times \frac{1}{12} = \frac{12}{228} = \frac{1}{19}$ feet per minute. Note that 1/19, .0526, 0.052, and 0.053 are examples of ways to enter a correct answer.
